title: 手動コンブ式製本機
description: 事務所や学校の印刷室に置く手動製本機。傾斜筐体、紙差込口外形と手前の受け台、幅ガイド、二十一個の固定開きフック、左右の支点/立ち上がったレバーと幅広握り、背面の閉じた屑受けを造形しています。紙・樹脂コンブは付属せず、各フックは一式の部品です。パンチ/開閉/製本は動作しない静的小物で、設置時は机の高さに合わせてください。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.483 × 0.344 × 0.360 m、4,384三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A manual binding machine for office and school print rooms. Its sloped housing includes a paper-slot exterior/rest, width guide, twenty-one fixed opening hooks, side pivots/raised operating lever with wide grip and a closed rear waste tray. No paper or plastic comb is included; all hooks belong to one assembly. Punching, opening and binding are not operational. Adjust this static prop to desk height. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.483 × 0.344 × 0.360 m; 4,384 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
